prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium abstract editorial icon, transparent PNG, for a Colombian oral-history visual publishing system shared by many communities.
Create ONE distinctive abstract glyph with this precise construction: three unequal curved paper lobes orbiting a tiny central opening.
Art direction: contemporary Latin American editorial modernism, quiet and sophisticated, physical cut-paper relief translated into a strong graphic silhouette. Bold simple organic geometry, open form, excellent intentional negative space. Sculptural but almost flat, one or two visible paper layers only. Tiny natural cut-edge irregularities and very subtle dry paper grain, clean controlled contour. Readable as an icon at 80 pixels and beautiful enlarged to 500 pixels. Not an illustration of a scene.
Palette: predominantly deep forest green #1c5c3f, with a restrained warm ochre #bc8c43 accent and at most one small clay #a95539 accent. No black circular backdrop, no badge, no enclosing tile or medallion. The silhouette itself is the whole artwork. No white backing layer. No drop shadow outside the cut paper. No gradients, glossy 3D, plastic, glow, photographic objects, faces, hands, animals, literal trees, landscapes or sacred/ethnic/tribal symbols. No writing, numbers, captions, letters, logos or watermarks.
Composition: centered square asset, whole glyph visible, fills approximately 72 percent of canvas, 14 percent clear padding on each edge, balanced but not mechanically symmetrical. All surroundings and all holes are genuinely transparent, preserve RGBA alpha, no checkerboard painted into the image. One icon only, no sheet, no variants.
